meta.disclaimer: Small-scale run on the supplied data on a CPU with a numpy implementation. If the input is a sample, every number is illustrative of the protocol, not a benchmark result.

explainability.score_unit: f = clip(log-odds of attack vs benign, +-20)/40 + 0.5 (calibrated source posterior); eta in f units (x40 = log-odds)

fairness_protocol.CEF-1 identical data and splits: enforced (same record set and split manifests for every model)
fairness_protocol.CEF-2 identical temporal ordering: enforced (all graph/temporal baselines built on interval-safe order)
fairness_protocol.CEF-3 declared information budget: Tier A only (flow records); J6 additionally uses delayed test labels (flagged)
fairness_protocol.CEF-4 identifier hygiene: enforced (addresses, ports, timestamps, ids, per-file constants excluded)
fairness_protocol.CEF-5 train-only fitting: enforced (scalers, PCA, oversamplers, priors fitted on training records)
fairness_protocol.CEF-6 equal tuning budget: NOT run here (single default configuration per model) - run the TPE budget
fairness_protocol.CEF-7 loss-reweighting access: enforced (logit adjustment available to every supervised model)
fairness_protocol.CEF-8 feature parity: enforced (all NF-v3 temporal/IAT fields given to every model)
fairness_protocol.CEF-9 graph-construction swap: partial (I8 and D6 run on the CTLG)
fairness_protocol.CEF-10 operating-point parity: enforced (split-conformal on benign validation for every model)
fairness_protocol.CEF-11 calibration parity: enforced (temperature scaling for every probabilistic model)
fairness_protocol.CEF-12 label-shift parity: EM correction reported for F only in this runner
fairness_protocol.CEF-13 streaming-harness parity: enforced (same micro-batch replay; each model's own construction cost)
fairness_protocol.CEF-15 seed parity: one seed per invocation - repeat with >= 5 seeds (--seed)
fairness_protocol.CEF-16 statistical-test parity: NOT in a single run - aggregate the per-seed JSON files
fairness_protocol.CEF-17 re-implementation validation: NOT performed - every dagger baseline is 'unvalidated'
fairness_protocol.CEF-18 failure accounting: enforced (failures recorded in the JSON, never dropped)
fairness_protocol.CEF-19 blind single-shot test: enforced (test split scored once per configuration)
fairness_protocol.CEF-20 artefact parity: config, manifests and code version recorded in the JSON
